name: Comprehensive Travel Insurance
description: Full cover including cancellation, medical, and baggage
longDescription: Our comprehensive travel insurance policy covers medical emergencies up to £10 million, trip cancellation or curtailment, lost or delayed baggage up to £2,500, and personal liability up to £2 million. Policy covers all passengers named on the booking.

name: Return Airport Transfers
description: Private coach transfer to and from the resort
longDescription: Door-to-door private coach transfers between the airport and your hotel. Air-conditioned vehicles with professional drivers. Meet & greet service included. Luggage assistance provided.

name: Ski Equipment Hire
description: Full ski or snowboard hire for the duration of your stay
longDescription: Quality ski or snowboard rental including skis or board, boots, helmet, and poles. Equipment is fitted by certified technicians at the resort. Upgrade to premium equipment available on arrival.

name: Ski School (6 Days)
description: Group lessons with qualified instructors — all abilities
longDescription: Six days of group ski lessons (2 hours each morning) with ESF-qualified instructors. Groups divided by ability from complete beginner to advanced. All instruction is in English. Maximum 8 people per group.

name: Room Upgrade
description: Upgrade to the next room category on arrival (subject to availability)
longDescription: Request a complimentary room upgrade on arrival. Subject to availability at check-in. Where an upgrade is available you will be moved to the next room category at no additional cost. Includes welcome fruit basket.

name: Half Board Dining Package
description: Breakfast and evening meal included every day
longDescription: Enjoy breakfast and a three-course dinner in the hotel restaurant every day of your stay. Includes a welcome cocktail on arrival. A selection of house wines and soft drinks included with dinner.
